capabilities: Open images in a full-screen viewer from Reading view or Live Preview
Zoom with the mouse wheel and pan by dragging, including pinch on mobile
Rotate, reset, and toggle between fit-to-window and 100% size
Copy an image to the clipboard or download the original file
Configure zoom increments, maximum zoom, and linked-image click behavior
extras: The community-plugin listing has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff yet; the README also documents privacy behavior and offers Chinese-language instructions.
problem: Long screenshots, mockups, diagrams, and high-resolution photos are constrained by note width, so inspecting details requires leaving the note or another application.
summary: Non-destructive image viewer that opens note images in a focused full-screen view with zoom, pan, rotate, copy, and download.
